column1: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE CONSTRUCTION

column2: INDUSTRY IN SRI LANKA; TO REGULATE, REGISTER, FORMALIZE
AND STANDARDIZE THE ACTIVITIES OF THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY;
TO PROVIDE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE NATIONAL ADVISORY
COUNCIL  ON  CONSTRUCTION;  THE  ESTABLISHMENT  OF  THE
CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY; AND THE
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT FUND
AND THE FUND OF THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY; TO PROVIDE MEASURES FOR THE IMPROVEMENT AND
WELLBEING  OF  THE  INDUSTRY  RELATED  PROFESSIONALS,
AND FOR THE SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTES RELATED TO CONSTRUCTION
ACTIVITIES; TO ENSURE PUBLIC SAFETY IN THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY
OF SRI LANKA; AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR

column1: Be it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: (1) This Act may be cited as the Construction Industry

column1: Development  Act,  No.  33  of  2014  and  shall  come  into
operation  on  such  date  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the
“appointed  date”)  as  the  Minister  may  appoint  by  Order

column2: (2)  This  Act  shall  apply  to  all  activities  relating  to  the

column1: construction  industry  within  the  Democratic  Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka, except otherwise provided herein.
